attendance.dashboardDesc: Below the marking form, totals per member and course, plus a Trainers tab for how much each trainer taught. Filter by trainer, member, or course.
attendance.intro: Attendance is the record of who showed up. It feeds the payroll, so mark it carefully.
attendance.markDesc: For each member assigned to the session, choose Present, Absent, or Late. A session with nobody assigned cannot be marked. Also mark whether the trainer was there.
attendance.sessionsDesc: Choose a course, then a session date and time range. If the session does not exist yet, create it first.
attendance.title: What you can do with attendance
attendance.trainerDesc: A session only counts toward a trainer's pay when the trainer is marked present.

courses.addDesc: Give it a title, required skills, a weekly schedule, and a price.
courses.detailDesc: See who is enrolled and which sessions already happened.
courses.enrollDesc: From a course, enroll members who signed up. A member can only be enrolled once per course at a time.
courses.intro: Courses are what you teach. Each one has required skills, a schedule, and a price.
courses.title: What you can do with courses
courses.assignDesc: In the Sessions section below the course table, tick the members who will attend a session. Attendance only checks the listed members, and a session with nobody assigned cannot be marked.

dashboard.intro: The dashboard is your overview. It shows money, attendance, and what is coming next, all computed from your data.
dashboard.moneyDesc: Revenue collected this month and the total of unpaid invoices. Overdue invoices are called out separately.
dashboard.nextDesc: Upcoming sessions and the most recent invoices, so you always know what needs attention.
dashboard.title: What you can do on the dashboard
dashboard.profileDesc: While your business name is empty, a reminder at the top of the dashboard opens a quick setup. The name, logo, tagline, address, and contacts you set appear on your invoices.

invoices.intro: Invoices are bills for members. Each one has a number, charges, a due date, and a status.
invoices.payDesc: A payment can cover the full amount or part of it. The invoice becomes Paid only when nothing is left.
invoices.statusDesc: Draft and Sent are set by you. Paid and Partially paid come from payments. Overdue is shown automatically when the due date has passed.
invoices.title: What you can do with invoices

members.addDesc: A name is required. Email and phone are optional, but they make search and contact easier.
members.detailDesc: See their enrollments and invoices in one place.
members.findDesc: Search matches name, email, and phone.
members.intro: Members are your students. Each one can enroll in courses and receive invoices.
members.title: What you can do with members

payroll.generateDesc: Pick a trainer and a period. The pay run counts the sessions where the trainer was present and multiplies by their rate.
payroll.intro: Payroll turns attended sessions into pay. A pay run is created per trainer, per period.
payroll.paidDesc: Once a pay run is marked paid it cannot be changed or deleted. Check the sessions first.
payroll.title: What you can do with payroll

settings.backupDesc: Download a backup ZIP of everything, or restore one. You can protect a backup with a passphrase.
settings.intro: Settings change how the app looks and behaves. Everything is stored on this device.
settings.languageDesc: The whole app switches language, including dates. Names and notes keep the text you typed.
settings.title: What you can do in settings
settings.tourDesc: Walk through the main screens again with short explanations.
settings.profileDesc: The first section in Settings. Set your business name, logo, tagline, address, and contacts; the business name is required, the rest is optional.

trainers.addDesc: A name is required. Add the subjects they teach and their rate per session, which payroll uses.
trainers.detailDesc: See their assigned courses and their pay runs.
trainers.findDesc: Search matches name, email, and phone.
trainers.intro: Trainers are your teachers. Each one has a rate per session and a list of subjects.
trainers.title: What you can do with trainers

trash.title: What you can do with the trash bin
trash.intro: Deleted members, trainers, courses, enrollments, sessions, invoices, payments, and pay runs wait here before they are removed permanently.
trash.restoreDesc: Put a record back where it was. If a newer record now uses the same number or booking, restoring is blocked until that conflict is resolved.
trash.emptyDesc: Remove one item for good, or empty the whole bin at once. Permanently deleted items cannot be recovered.

hint.coursePrice: The price of the course. Used on invoices.
hint.courseRequiredSkills: Skills a trainer must have at least one of to teach a session of this course. Leave empty and any trainer can teach it.
hint.courseSchedule: The regular weekly days for this course.
hint.invoiceDueDate: When the member should pay by. Overdue is shown automatically after this date.
hint.invoiceCharges: One charge per row. The total is the sum of the charges.
hint.memberEmail: Optional. Used for search and for contacting the member.
hint.memberName: Required. This is the name shown everywhere.
hint.memberNotes: Anything worth remembering about this member, up to 2000 characters.
hint.memberPhone: Optional. Used for search and for contacting the member.
hint.paymentAmount: Never more than the amount still owed on this invoice.
hint.paymentDetails: Where the customer should pay, for example a bank account or e-wallet number.
hint.payrollPeriod: A pay run covers one trainer for one period. Generating again refreshes a draft run from the latest attendance.
hint.trainerRate: What this trainer is paid per session. Payroll multiplies it by the sessions attended.
hint.trainerSubjects: Type a skill and press Enter to add it. Suggestions come from skills already used.

payroll.alreadyExists: A pay run already exists for this trainer and period.
payroll.emptyHint: Pick a trainer and a period, then generate a pay run from attended sessions.
payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.unpaidHint: Sessions where the trainer was absent are not paid.

backups.body: A backup is a ZIP file saved to your device. It contains all of your records and is not encrypted unless you chose a passphrase, so store it as carefully as the records themselves. Checksums detect corruption but do not prove who made a file, so only restore backups you trust.
backups.title: Backups

card.summary: Your data stays on this device. Olaseena has no account, no tracking and no third-party requests.

changes.body: If this policy changes, the new version and its date will appear on this page.
changes.title: Changes

control.body: You can delete members, trainers, courses, invoices and pay runs, or clear this site's data in your browser settings at any time. Clearing site data permanently removes everything Olaseena stored, so create a backup first if you want to keep it.
control.title: Your control

hosting.body: The site is served as static files through GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub may keep standard technical logs of requests, such as IP address and time, under its own privacy statement. Olaseena itself cannot see or control those logs.
hosting.title: Hosting

privacy.intro: Olaseena is a local-first app for running a private course business. It runs entirely in your browser. This page explains what that means for your data.

limits.body: A browser may clear its storage when a device runs low on space, and storage is not shared between browsers or devices. Create backups regularly.
limits.title: Good to know

local.body: Members, trainers, courses, enrollments, sessions, attendance, invoices, payments, pay runs and your settings are saved in this browser's storage (IndexedDB and localStorage). Olaseena has no server, no account and no cloud database, so nothing you enter is sent to us or to anyone else.
local.title: Your data stays on your device

terms.body: Olaseena is open source under the MIT License. It is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, and the authors are not liable for data loss or damage arising from its use.
terms.title: License and terms

privacy.title: Privacy & Policy

tracking.body: Olaseena does not use analytics, advertising, tracking cookies, or third-party scripts, fonts and images. The page only loads files from its own address.
tracking.title: No tracking

restore.confirmBody: From {name}: {added} added and {replaced} replaced. Everything else stays as it is.
restore.doneBody: The backup data you chose is now part of your data.
restore.drop: Drop a backup here or choose a file
restore.intro: Choose a backup ZIP created by Olaseena. It is fully checked and compared with your data before anything changes.
restore.passphraseHint: Leave blank for an unencrypted backup.
restore.replaceNote: Restoring never deletes existing data. New records are added, and records you choose to replace are overwritten. Everything is applied at once and undone automatically if verification fails.
restore.safety: Download a safety backup of my current data first

data.body: Your records stay on your device. The optional Google Drive backup stores an encrypted copy in your own Drive app folder; only you hold the passphrase. You are responsible for your own data and for keeping backups.
data.title: Your data

terms.intro: Olaseena is a local-first app for running a private course business. By using it, you agree to these terms.

service.body: Olaseena is a local-first app for running a private course business, for one user. It runs entirely in your browser; there is no account and no server.
service.title: The service

terms.title: Terms of Service

use.body: Use the app for your own business records. Do not use it for anything unlawful.
use.title: Acceptable use

warranty.body: The app is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. The authors are not liable for data loss or damage arising from its use.
warranty.title: No warranty

attendance.body: This is where you record who showed up (attendance). Pick a session, mark each assigned member Present, Absent, or Late, and mark whether the trainer was there. A session with nobody assigned cannot be marked. Sessions where the trainer was present count toward their pay. Below the marking, a dashboard totals attendance per member and course, with a Trainers tab for how much each trainer taught.
attendance.title: Attendance

courses.body: This is where your classes live (courses). Each course has required skills, weekly days, and a price. Open one to enroll members and see its sessions. Each session has a start and end time, and its length is worked out from them. Below the course table, the Sessions section lists the sessions not yet marked done, so you can see which members will attend each one and assign them there.
courses.title: Courses

dashboard.body: This is your overview (the dashboard). It shows money collected this month, unpaid invoices, how often members show up, and what is coming next. While your business name is empty, a reminder here opens a quick setup for your business profile.
dashboard.title: Dashboard

drive.body: This is where your backups can also live (Google Drive). Connect your account to back up and restore from your own Drive app folder, and switch on auto-sync to upload a fresh encrypted copy a few seconds after each change — it needs the backup passphrase first.
drive.title: Google Drive

invoices.body: This is where you bill members (invoices). Create one from a member or an enrollment, add charges, and record payments. Overdue invoices are flagged automatically when the due date passes.
invoices.title: Invoices

members.body: This is your student list (members). Add members here, search them by name, email, or phone, and open one to see their enrollments and invoices.
members.title: Members

payroll.body: This is where trainers get paid (payroll). Pick a trainer and a period, and a pay run is generated from the sessions where the trainer was present, times their rate per session.
payroll.title: Payroll

settings.body: This is where you change the language, make backups, and replay this tour (settings). Your business profile sits at the top: its name, logo, and contacts show on your invoices. Backups are ZIP files you keep on your own device.
settings.title: Settings

trainers.body: This is your teacher list (trainers). Each trainer has subjects they teach and a rate per session, which payroll uses to compute their pay.
trainers.title: Trainers

trash.title: Trash bin
trash.body: This is where deleted records wait (trash bin). They stay here until the auto-delete time runs out, so a mistake can be undone. Restore one, or delete it permanently.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.body: This is your business profile (business profile). Set your business name, logo, tagline, address, and contacts here. The business name and owner's name also identify new records, and the name and contacts appear on every invoice.

courseSessions.title: Sessions
courseSessions.body: This section lists every session whose attendance has not been checked yet, soonest first, with the course each session belongs to. Once a session is marked, it leaves this list. Open a session here to choose exactly which members will attend it.
